study.question: Do explicit historical action codes improve full-population validation click AUC beyond aligned historical item content and retained historical task-mask paths in the strongest visible model, and does event alignment matter beyond action composition?
study.hypothesis: The incumbent may benefit from action codes through global composition, through alignment to item/order, or merely through an alternative representation of task memberships. Its observed click AUC does not isolate these routes. A fresh unchanged full-use control versus an action-blind constant learned channel and a counts-only replacement tests conditional representation utility at identical nominal capacity. A within-row exact-membership cyclic replacement tests residual alignment only where multiple action codes occur in the same stratum; absent variation it is structurally uninformative.

nearest_work.difference: Immediate architectural parent. Inherit its entire forward architecture, true-label joint loss and surrogate context VJP. Change only historical action vectors before every action-sensitive summary and score. No new architecture or novelty claim.

Archived DIN primary text describes target-conditioned local activation and weighted history pooling. The supplied local DIN is a four-task field adaptation with action values. This proposal audits action utility inside the stronger imported model; it does not claim an original pooling mechanism or exact DIN reproduction.

Pinned benchmark forward lines 123-170 explicitly initialize task sequence hubs from task masks. This motivates preserving mask paths in the controls, not adoption of hubs or broadcast blocks. Original author-paper equivalence is unverified.

Pinned benchmark forward lines 123-153 adds action embeddings to item embeddings before unified interaction. That establishes a nearby representation choice, not local effectiveness. Our intervention isolates action representation in the incumbent rather than adding transduction or sparsity.

Pinned loader lines 383-408 derives four-mask memberships from action-token names; lines 535-551 constructs prefix masks and zero target action. Injectivity of the actual action vocabulary is NOT established without authorized host metadata/preflight. We preserve these host inputs exactly.

inherited_components: Entire standalone source and CONFIG of g3-r0065-fixed_angle_cycle_source_bit_negative except the documented historical-action intervention and optional label-free diagnostics in replacement files.
Shared field/action embeddings; target-conditioned action-aware scorer; uniform/feedback block compression, ordinal/quadratic/match summaries, folded training Dice support and pruned evaluation.
All four task towers, residual adapters, product context-history interactions, auxiliary gradient ownership, true-label training loss and surrogate collected context transfer.
Frozen host inputs, masks, padding, initialization, data exposure and selection protocol.
study.proposed_difference: Four standalone arms: byte-identical full-use control; learned action-independent mean codebook vector; per-row action-histogram mean broadcast to valid events; and deterministic action-embedding cycles within exact historical task-membership strata. All replacements occur before any compression, match/position summary or score, covering both action-as-value and action-as-scorer inputs. No new trainable modules, RNG draws, input fields, training labels or state are introduced.
predictions: If explicit action representation has consequential utility, full use should outperform blind by at least 0.0002 absolute click AUC under the same host seed and exposure; this margin is a prospective practical screen, not an established significance threshold.
If global composition suffices, counts-only should fall within +/-0.0002 of full across paired repetitions; one point estimate in that band is not an equivalence finding.

If residual action-event alignment matters beyond all four memberships, an adequately supported within-membership cycle should lower click AUC versus full. If codes are determined by memberships or homogeneous in every within-row stratum, it should preserve action vectors exactly and be uninformative.

Every arm should retain 32192421 nominal parameters and identical state-dict shapes. Blind codebook work, histogram reduction and permutation sorting may add runtime, so no speedup is predicted merely from removing alignment.
falsifiers: Blind matches or exceeds full across informative paired comparisons, undermining the claim that explicit action-code use is required under this recipe.
Counts-only is adequately equivalent or superior, undermining a need for action-event binding in this architecture.
A supported conditional cycle has no reproducible penalty, providing no controlled support for residual alignment; identity cycles instead invalidate this contrast.

Any changed host mask, item/context content, parameter shape, initialization, padding, target action, label/visibility boundary, loss rule or surrogate VJP invalidates the intended attribution until corrected.

If rerunning byte-identical full use fails to reproduce the imported reference within documented execution/seed variation, resolve that execution discrepancy before treating differences as action evidence.
alternative_explanations: Nominal parameter count and channel dimension are matched; effective information dimension, gradients, activation scale and action-table row exposure can differ.
The inherited context backward is a surrogate VJP rather than the ordinary derivative of the reported BCE. Changed action inputs can change those downstream cotangents.

The incumbent consumes the union of auxiliary memberships, not all four mask bits separately. Full versus blind alone tests explicit-code representation utility under this fixed architecture, not information beyond every available membership bit.
A single frozen training seed and one-pass optimization cannot establish repeated support or equivalence.
Action tokens can encode membership combinations already supplied to the host. Improvements may reflect convenient nonlinear encoding of those memberships rather than additional raw information.

Counts-only broadcasts a learned histogram projection and changes its interactions with support Dice populations; representational scaling or one-pass optimization can cause differences without proving information necessity.

Only DIN and the imported incumbent are visible local trajectories. The incumbent ancestor named in its receipt and any earlier failures/abandoned branches are unavailable; no invented audit or causal explanation of their gains is asserted.
All results concern official_offline history; delayed historical feedback maturity and publisher static snapshots limit production interpretations.

variants.name: action_full
variants.note: Unchanged incumbent utility control, byte-identical source SHA256 ef231472aca84aeadd095e12b3b3c4840ea86cd7a5ae6f4dd77c1f97a0be05ce. Must be rerun alongside replacements; imported AUC is provenance rather than a paired rerun result. Expected 32192421 parameters, host must remeasure. Preserves inherited surrogate VJP.

variants.name: action_blind
variants.note: Before all compression/scoring/detail summaries, replace historical action vectors on valid events by the learned uniform mean of existing nonzero, nonpadding codebook rows. Same table and complete architecture; constant channel independent of row actions. Original padding embeddings and target action remain untouched. Extra codebook lookups have measured cost; row exposure and scale differ. Candidate module has optional action_control_diagnostics, not an automatic host collector.

variants.name: action_counts_only
variants.note: Replace each valid historical action vector by the row-wide masked mean of historical action embeddings. This is a learned fixed-width projection of the normalized full action histogram; inherited history counts retain length. Removes binding to item, position, block and membership while preserving all raw masks and non-action representations. No extra parameters. Target and padded positions untouched. A counts-only tie would favor global composition sufficiency for this architecture, not prove equivalence.

variants.name: action_within_membership_cycle
variants.note: Cycle historical action embeddings within each individual row and exact four-mask membership stratum, preserving per-row per-stratum action counts. Item order, raw host inputs, target, padding, masks and modules are untouched. Deterministic cyclic derangement is not a random conditional-independence test. Run label-free preflight before interpretation: no within-row heterogeneity means identity and an UNINFORMATIVE contrast. Cross-row-only heterogeneity does not help this control. No code or mask mismatch is introduced.

preflight_required_before_interpretation: Host verifies original dataset/protocol hashes and ordinary unshared unencoded action embedding. Local coding environment has no dataset or torch; existing readiness receipts are inherited, not reexecuted.

Instantiate every arm from the same host seed. Compare state-dict keys/shapes, initial learned weights, parameter totals and host RNG after construction against action_full. Expect total 32192421; verify sparse/dense optimizer grouping is unchanged.

Run label-free action_control_diagnostics on the replacement module over authorized training batches with host costs charged. Aggregate valid_events/rows and changed_events/rows; inspect authorized action-vocabulary mapping for code-to-membership collisions. No raw future histories or labels enter this check. This optional method has no automatic harness collector: absent explicit invocation, support remains UNKNOWN.

If no changed rows in a full training-prefix audit, record cycle UNINFORMATIVE and do not allocate repetitions to it. If host cannot skip an already registered arm, still charge it and interpret it as an identity execution check only.

Verify actual PyTorch forward/backward, finite four-task predictions and joint loss in train/eval; randomize only padding entries to verify invariance; hold target action at unknown zero. Compare tensor snapshots to ensure no host input is overwritten by the new intervention.

Using identical weights, test blind invariance to all valid historical raw-action changes with masks fixed; counts invariance to within-row action permutations; and within-membership cycle preservation of exact task memberships and per-stratum raw-code counts.

For empty rows confirm original action padding representations are unchanged; at identical weights, all arm predictions equal on empty histories in eval. Do not demand separately trained empty-history predictions match because training can change shared context parameters.

For codes deterministic from exact memberships verify cycle action tensors and predictions equal full with the same weights; compare forward/backward gradients and buffers to roundoff tolerance under BF16. This checks intervention identity, not action utility.
validation_plan.metrics: Primary is all 2871767 validation samples click ROC-AUC. Report four-task AUC and unweighted Logloss, auxiliary mean separately, parameters and active row exposure, training/wall/allocated GPU seconds, examples processed, peak memory, model inference throughput and whole-batch p50/p95. Report overhead of diagnostics separately and include it in the budget.
validation_plan.uncertainty: Use paired user-cluster bootstrap of full versus each replacement only where an authorized host prediction/cluster interface exists; no raw user ID is available to model forward, so do not invent such access. Use the same predeclared 0.0002 practical margin; report paired deltas and intervals if available, adjusting interpretation for multiple contrasts. Without authorized extra seeds/bootstrap, label conclusions preliminary and do not claim statistical or practical equivalence.
validation_plan.slices: Predeclared available history bins: empty, 1-16, 17-64, >64. If authorized host diagnostics permit, additionally bin cycle changed-events as 0, 1-4, >=5 per row and original auxiliary-mask union as 0 versus >0; report sample/positive/negative counts and mark insufficient slices. Hour/frequency/unseen-field slices require host metadata and remain unavailable here.
validation_plan.selection_and_holdout: Select on full-population validation click AUC and measured cost, retaining unresolved alternatives. Freeze chosen candidate, full utility control, key replacements, exact source/config/checkpoint hashes, allowable repetition seeds and comparison commands before any separately authorized closed assessment. No held-out feedback is requested or used.
validation_plan.interpretation: Full-versus-blind utility is conditional on this architecture and surrogate optimizer. Counts-versus-full concerns global composition sufficiency. Only supported within-membership cycling targets alignment beyond all four memberships. When membership determines codes, the latter is nonidentifiable by this perturbation; a later explicit membership-reconstruction study is a different prospective question.
